_meta.rationale: Validate momentum-gap escape hatch (release calm-hold when winner_mom - held_mom > threshold) against historical analogues to the May 2026 paper-run GLD trap. Primary question: would the fix help in similar past situations (anti-overfit check)?
_meta.decision: REJECTED — gap escape does help paper window (Gap20: +0.67% vs -7.93% baseline daily), and slightly improves 20y (+1.96%) and 15y (+0.30%). But it hurts 5y (-2.39%) and 10y (-1.44%), materially hurts 2013_lag (-3.61%), and does not trigger in the most analogous historical period (2023_recov, 0%). The paper-window improvement is one data point and structurally identical scenarios in history don't validate it. Consistent with the 20y validation that already documented this strategy 'loses in V-shaped recoveries' as an accepted weakness.

key_findings: Gap20 is the safest variant: +1.96% on 20y, +0.30% on 15y, ~0 trigger on 2023_recov.
All gap variants hurt 2013_lag by -3.6% (rotated to wrong asset). CalmOff would have helped +8.4% there.
Daily cadence matters: monthly cadence with Gap15/CalmOff rotated to DBC at month-end (-15.18%) instead of XLK mid-month.
The most analogous historical period (2023_recov, post-SVB tech rally) does not trigger any gap variant — preserves baseline. Suggests paper-window improvement may not generalize.
Documented strategy weakness in 20y validation: 'loses in V-shaped recoveries' — paper window is consistent with this, not a parameter bug.
